lines.t: Every summer I see the strangest things Little sprouts popping up with no strings
Didn't plant no seeds, at least not here But something funky's growing every year
Maybe the birds had a garden plan Or the raccoons formed a compass clan
They're planting crops like undercover spies
In my garden it's a veggie surprise
Oh, it's the mystery garden boogie
The compost makes it groovy
From cherry tops to melon sweet
Don't know what's popping up by my feet
Yeah, the mystery garden boogie
It's growing wild and loopy
Maybe next year I'll find a tree
That's half a squash, half a kiwi

One summer came, a cantaloupe vine. Next year a watermelon looked mighty fine. Now I've got a cucumber-melon blend. Nature's humor just won't end. Critters playin' farmer all night long. Tossin' seeds where they don't belong. Every pot a science fair show. Will it be a fruit or veggie? I don't know.
Oh, it's the mystery garden boogie
The compost makes it groovy
From cherry tops to melon sweet
Don't know what's poppin' up by my feet
Yeah, the mystery garden boogie
With veggies all mixed and cookie
Guess it's nature's way to say
Why plant a garden anyway?
Got my shovel, got my hat
Waitin' to see what sprouts from that
Could be dinner, could be art
Could be a salad with a mystery heart
Oh, the mystery garden boogie
Nature's pranks a doozy
From cucamelons to who knows what
I'm just rolling with the compost pie
Yeah, the mystery garden boogie
Wild, weird, and moody
Sing it loud, planet proud
That's my mystery garden crowd
Thanks for watching!
